reviewer_criticism: Why does greedy soup remain strong?

more_data_needed: No for explaining greedy soup as a strong empirical validation-descent baseline; yes only for a new claim that another method robustly beats greedy soup.
minimal_experiment_if_needed: For any new candidate family, rerun full greedy-soup trajectory logging with candidate-soup validation accuracy/loss before each accept/reject decision and paired CIs versus ordinary greedy soup.
optional_or_essential: Optional for explanation; essential for any soup-beating claim.
claim_boundary: Greedy soup remains the empirical validation-descent boundary unless paired CIs directly support a challenger.
